description: One sport's fitted parameter set for the Simulation Lab engine (Quant Apparatus spec §4, contract 5). parameters use neutral names (leagueAvg, homeEdge) — the native fit files call them leagueAvgPoints/homeEdgePoints for every sport, including runs- and goals-scored leagues; the mapping in contracts/README.md records that. playerStatSDs values are 'fitted' or 'parameter' grade depending on playerStatSDSource (NBA/NFL fitted from harvested logs; MLB/NHL tagged parameters at v1) — the source string travels with the artifact so no consumer mistakes a parameter for a fit.

fitVersion.description: Native fit files are unversioned; the mapping assigns '0' (spec §4: the four existing fit JSONs are FitArtifact v0 instances). The fit pipeline (Phase C) mints real versions.

homeEdge.description: Home advantage in the sport's scoring unit (points / runs / goals).

leagueAvg.description: League-average scoring per team per game, in the sport's unit.

playerStatSDs.description: Per-stat within-player residual SDs, keyed by the sport's taxonomy stat names.

producedBy.description: Script + commit that produced the fit. Native files carry a prose provenance string instead — a known gap (see README).

teams.description: Per-team shrunk scoring means: PF/PA = points (runs/goals) for/against, split home/away. Keys are canonical team names.

title: FitArtifact
